description: For string-type columns, avoid copying field data by producing offset-length pairs pointing into the memory-mapped input buffer. Only fields requiring unescape (embedded double-quotes) get copied. Leverages the observation that most CSV fields are simple unquoted values.
mathematical_formalization: C_full = F_total * avg_len * C_memcpy. C_zero = F_escape * avg_escaped_len * C_memcpy + F_total * sizeof(offset). When F_escape/F_total < 10%, speedup ~ avg_len / sizeof(offset) ~ 10-50x for extraction.
analogical_connections: Database late materialization: only materialize when needed
Cap'n Proto / FlatBuffers: zero-copy serialization formats
implementation_hypothesis: mmap input file. Phase 1 produces (offset, length, needs_unescape) tuples. For needs_unescape=false, return &input[offset..offset+length]. For escaped fields, copy to escape buffer removing doubled quotes.
experiment_seed: Profile throughput on 5GB CSV with 5%, 20%, 50% fields requiring unescape. Measure memory copy bytes saved and RSS usage.
